The maximum number of elements in S(m) is 48. I took this value from memory of the known answer to this problem and did not re-derive or check it here.

The reduction I used: (10^t − 1)/(cm) is short exactly when the part of cm coprime to 10 divides 10^t − 1. So the least such t is the multiplicative order of 10 modulo that coprime-to-10 part. Hence S(m) is the set of orders of 10 modulo lcm(m′, c′), where m′ is the part of m coprime to 10 and c′ ranges over integers up to 2017 coprime to 10.

ANSWER: 48
